summary: Data Scientist with hands-on experience building computer vision and generative AI systems in production, plus the data pipelines and cloud infrastructure that support them. I work daily in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and LangChain, and I've trained and deployed a custom detection and segmentation model to production using AWS SageMaker. Hands-on with modern detection and segmentation architectures (YOLO, RT-DETR, Detectron2, ResNet) and agentic AI systems (RAG, MCP, LLM tool-use).
